scope.claim: Screen and rank wide-range positive stored-FP32 reduction trees under the frozen synthetic distribution.
not_claimed: a rigorous error bound or safety certificate

experimental_unit: one ordered stored-FP32 input group; its 64 graph rows are paired

stored_input.dtype: positive normal IEEE-754 binary32 represented exactly
stored_input.materialization: wide_range_random samples exponent uniformly from [-32,4], a uniform 23-bit fraction field, then shuffles with Python random.Random(seed)
stored_input.ordering: the generated shuffled order is consumed unchanged
stored_input.validity: all 64 graph observations must complete; otherwise exclude the whole group from primary analysis and preserve failure metadata

heldout_seeds.policy: first 31 bits of SHA256('wide_range_energy_beam_v1|<width>|<index>'), indices 0..31; explicitly materialized below before opening

target.raw_preserved: exact signed root forward error as a rational and in root-ULP units
target.ties: all equal minimum targets form the oracle best tier
target.degenerate_group: if all targets tie, hit is one and normalized regret is zero; ranking correlation is undefined

predictor.macro_score: selected connected root-band ULP energy divided by 12; lower is better
predictor.micro_score: joint cell-beam expected squared signed root error in root-ULP units; lower is better
predictor.allowed_inputs: stored leaves, candidate graph, deterministic shadow features, and innovation model fitted only on declared calibration groups

baselines.q_only: minimum frozen 80%-energy-mass macro score over all 64 trees
baselines.fixed_k8_beam3: K=8 macro shortlist of four followed by B=3 joint beam
baselines.random: exact group-wise expectation under uniform selection of one of 64 trees

metrics.primary: mean paired normalized-regret improvement: regret(Q-only) - regret(frozen cascade)
metrics.positive_evidence_rule: the 95% stratified group-bootstrap interval lower bound for the primary metric is greater than zero
metrics.normalization: within each group, (selected target - group minimum)/(group maximum - group minimum); zero when all targets tie
metrics.undefined_reporting: undefined pairwise accuracy or rho is retained as null and its defined-group count is reported
metrics.weighting: each input group has equal weight; pooled bootstrap preserves equal width allocation

opening.required_worktree: clean Git worktree containing this frozen preregistration
opening.overwrite: forbidden; an existing or partial directory blocks execution
opening.after_opening: score, target, sampling unit, primary metric, and uncertainty procedure are immutable; changes require a new validation stage
